PROYECTS.TITLE: Not just ideas, but facts.
PROYECTS.DESCRIPTION: These are some of the projects I have developed

items.title: NeuroScreen-A
items.description: Full-stack web application for the early detection of alcoholism through the analysis of EEG records and a deep learning model. The application offers features such as user authentication, patient management, EEG file uploading for real-time predictions, and a dashboard with interpretability visualization of the results. This project was developed as part of my undergraduate thesis in Systems Engineering, with the goal of providing an accessible clinical tool for the early detection of alcohol use disorders using neurological biomarkers.
items.problem: Need for accessible clinical tools for early detection of alcohol use disorders using neurological biomarkers.
features: Login/Logout with JWT and session persistence
EEG file upload and real-time predictions
contributions: Database model design and backend architecture
Implementation of authentication and security with JWT
Development of the critical flow: EEG upload → prediction → interpretability
Application of best practices and system structure
Support in UX/UI improvements for key components

items.title: LeetCode Clone
items.description: Web platform for programming exercises inspired by LeetCode. Developed with Flask, it allows users to solve programming problems, submit solutions, and view their results.
items.problem: Create a local environment for algorithm practice with a code editor and automatic solution evaluation.
features: Practice exercises with Python, Ruby, or Java
Code editor with submit and automatic evaluation
contributions: Modern, clean interface design focused on user experience
Implementation of the code submission flow from the frontend
Integration with the backend for execution and evaluation of solutions

items.title: CaliNema
items.description: Find movies and showtimes for all theaters in Cali in one place. Developed in Astro, CaliNema is a prototype website that displays all movies and daily showtimes available in Cali's theaters. Movie information is obtained through the CaliNema API.
items.problem: Need for a centralized platform to check local cinema releases and schedules in real-time.
features: Consumption of CaliNema API for real-time data
Movie listing with details and schedules
contributions: Full design and implementation of the frontend
Consumption and integration of own API
Definition of user experience and visual structure

items.title: CaliNema API
items.description: Developed in Django REST Framework, the CaliNema API performs web scraping of the websites of the five cinema chains in the city of Cali to obtain all available movies and showtimes.
items.problem: Centralize and normalize cinema listing data scattered across multiple websites.
features: Automatic web scraping of cinema sites
contributions: Implementation of web scraping system for multiple cinemas
Database design and information normalization
Development of REST endpoints for external consumption
Automation of listing updates

items.title: Pokédex
items.description: Interactive Pokémon explorer. This web application was developed with Vite and React, consuming the PokéAPI to show detailed information about different Pokémon. It integrates React Three Fiber to render 3D models and elements, offering a dynamic visual experience.
items.problem: Create an interactive Pokémon exploration experience with 3D element visualization.
features: 3D rendering with Three.js and React Three Fiber
contributions: Interactive interface design
Integration with PokéAPI
Implementation of data visualization and user experience

items.title: RadioApp
items.description: Global radio station explorer, developed with Vite and React, using the public Radio Browser API to display radio stations from around the world. It highlights Colombian stations on the main page.
items.problem: Provide a centralized and simple interface to discover and play live radio stations.
features: Station search by country and genre
contributions: Complete user interface design
Integration with Radio Browser API
Implementation of live radio playback

items.title: X-ray Classification
items.description: Repository with a machine learning project focused on exploring different automatic classification techniques for chest X-rays using convolutional neural networks (CNN) and transfer learning models (VGG16 and ResNet50).
items.problem: Automate the detection and classification of pathologies in chest X-rays for clinical second opinions.
contributions: Training and evaluation of CNN models (VGG16, ResNet50)
Parallel experimentation for best-performing model selection
Metrics analysis and results validation
Technical paper writing in IEEE format

items.title: Menu USB
items.description: Developed in Django, MenuUSB is a prototype website with unofficial information that allows users to consult all menus from the San Buenaventura University shops in one place, facilitating daily consultation for students, executives, and university workers.
items.problem: Centralize menu information distributed among multiple university shops.
contributions: UI design for landing page and dashboard
Implementation of key visual components
Support in the development of CRUD functionalities

items.title: Elite Democracy
items.description: Web page developed as an academic project for the Constitution and Democracy subject. It describes characteristics and provides examples of what elite democracy means, with structured educational content.
items.problem: Present complex political science concepts in a clear and accessible way for students.
